Name: Earthy Cursor - For Earthy Recolour
Author: sqltaire
Description:
i’m excited to share my first mod with you all, and i truly hope you enjoy it!

this can be viewed as an add-on to [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/13658]daisyniko's earthy interface[/url] & [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5255]earthy recolour[/url]!

i made this because i really love this recolour and wanted to create a cursor that complements it.
it isn't much but i really hope you all like it.﻿

[size=4][b]installation instructions:[/b][/size]

1. download the mod file to your device
2. extract the .zip file
3. place it in your stardew valley/mods folder
4. run the game using stardewmoddingapi.exe
if you see your new cursor that means you succesfulyl installed the mod! enjoy.
